**<sub><sub>![P2 Badge](https://img.shields.io/badge/P2-yellow?style=flat)</sub></sub>  Normalize equivalent full addresses before declaring conflicts**

When the stored or claimed site uses common equivalent forms such as `100 Main Street, Austin, Texas` versus `100 Main St, Austin, TX`, `normalized_identity()` produces different strings, so a single valid claim becomes `UNKNOWN` and two equivalent claims become `CONFLICT`. This loses current site support and manufactures a contradiction despite both values identifying the same complete location; canonicalize street and state forms, or compare structured address components while still rejecting explicit city/state disagreements.

AGENTS.md reference: [AGENTS.md:L6-L6](https://github.com/nrsandoval1231-oss/gl3/blob/27c8cefe77e81ab65bb4e12ecac05fef47bd36bb/AGENTS.md#L6-L6)
